title: Microplastic Extraction Using Calcium Chloride Density Separation
author: Rodina, Roth, et al.

steps.title: Prepare compost sample
steps.instruction: Weigh 1 g of blank or spiked compost, add 20 mL ultrapure water, and ultrasonicate for 5 min at 40 % amplitude using a Branson Digital Sonifier SFX 550 while keeping the tube in an ice bath to prevent overheating.

steps.title: Add LDPE to sample
steps.instruction: Add the specified amount of LDPE (e.g., 109.1 mg or 144.9 mg of pristine LDPE, or 142.5 mg–113.4 mg of UV‑aged LDPE) to the compost before sonication, then continue with the established extraction protocol.
